main_question: string - the question the text tries to answer
structure: string - one sentence describing how the atoms form the argument

atoms.title: string - declarative sentence, at most 12 words
atoms.statement: string - the self-contained idea in 1-3 sentences, symbols defined
atoms.kind: definition | assumption | claim | method | result | evidence | question | hypothesis
atoms.evidence: string - short quote (<= 40 words) or close paraphrase from the text
atoms.locator: string - section / page / equation, or empty
depends_on: integer - 0-based indices of other atoms in this list
